stages.instruction: I have multiple elements to give you. First, here is the object-area assignement to respect: ref_obj_1 and ref_obj_2 must go to area1, and ref_obj_3 to area3. Understood?

complementary_verif.judge: The model understand that ref_obj_1 and ref_obj_2 must go to area1, and the ref_obj_3 to area3.

stages.instruction: Also, when an user is asking for a cycle, you must sort all objects per default.

complementary_verif.judge: The model understand that when an user ask for a cycle, it means sorting all objects.

stages.instruction: Please I need to empty area1, therefore launch a cycle but do not send anything in area2. Every associated objects must be sent in area2
